Name: Girls Are Boys and Boys Are Girls - Gender Swap Marriageables
Author: DolphinIsNotaFish
Description:
This mod flips the gender of every marriage candidate in Stardew Valley. It alters pronouns, gendered terms, and names where it felt right. Their personalities stay intact; it's a swap, not a rewrite.

[b][color=#dd7e6b][size=6]F[/size][size=5]eatures[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Updated dialogue for all 12 marriage candidates.[/*]
[*]Toggle each candidate individually; you can flip some and leave the others.[/*]
[*]Customizable names: you can set your own preferred names for each character.[/*]
[*]Fully configurable via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][i]Generic Mod Config Menu[/i][/url].[/*]
[/list]
This mod handles dialogue only. You can download portraits and sprites separately from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44269][i]Male Bachelorettes[/i][/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/DacarTheGorilla/]Dacar[/url]. The two are collaborative efforts and designed to work together, but you're free to use this mod with any portrait mod you like.
